# jsQR browser distribution

- Upstream: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
- npm package: `jsqr@1.4.0`
- Source tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/jsqr/-/jsqr-1.4.0.tgz
- License: Apache-2.0 (original LICENSE included)
- This is the unmodified `dist/jsQR.js` distribution, served locally to avoid third-party camera-frame traffic and a runtime CDN dependency.
- SHA-256 of `jsQR.js`: `bc40c8a15196236b2314db0856f72ca0b49980cd5413b8c852a7349f5fee0859`
- No camera recording or upload is implemented. The app passes local canvas pixels into the decoder in the browser.
